spanish: Jehová nuestro Dios habló a nosotros en Joreb, diciendo: Bastante a ustedes el sentar en este monte.

findings.issue: Qal infinitive of sit/dwell is rendered as transitive sentar (to seat), shifting stem force from the addressees sitting or dwelling to a causative seating.
Unmarked el adds an article on the anarthrous infinitive construct so it can stand as a Spanish noun.
Bastante leans toward sufficiency; the construct adjective licenses much/great and leaves that openness.

notes: Jehová, nuestro Dios, habló, a nosotros, en Joreb, diciendo, a ustedes, and en este monte match the tokens.
